## Overview

Audit issue-specific labelling rules in `.github/labeler.yml` and compare against PR-side maturity.

## In-Scope

- Issue rule coverage and rule quality
- Title/body/metadata heuristic checks

## Audit Checklist

- [ ] Issue rule blocks identified and documented
- [ ] Coverage gaps listed by scenario
- [ ] Risk and false-positive/negative notes captured

## Deliverables

- Issue rule coverage report
- Prioritised recommendations
